evidence_added.title: Inhibitory Circuits in the Basolateral Amygdala in Aversive Learning and Memory
evidence_added.quote_text: PV+ cells have been separated into basket cells, axo-axonic chandelier cells and AStria cells
evidence_added.method: asta_snippet — Leroy & Bhatt 2021 review: PV chandelier cells in BLA — basket vs axo-axonic distinction
evidence_added.scope: rodent basolateral amygdala, review of in vivo optogenetics and in vitro electrophysiology
evidence_added.rationale: Directly names axo-axonic chandelier cells as a PV+ subtype in BLA, supporting morphological classification. PMID:33994955 was not in existing refs.
